name: Sz 81
notes: Sz 81 A+B binary (0.26 arcsec, ~41 au); SMA/ALMA 0.87 mm compact disk (Curone et al. 2026)

images.wavelength_label: 0.87 mm continuum (343.5 GHz; robust 0.5; Sz 81A, smooth but possible shallow inner cavity)

paper.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks

images.note: Panel label inside figure: Sz 81A (the companion Sz 81B lies 1.93" = 304 au away, outside this panel; see the separate wide-field record). R68(Sz 81A) = 5.29 au (0.0337"). No substructure visible in the CLEAN image, but the real visibilities fall below zero at ~4 Mlambda and the frank profile has a flat central component, possibly a shallow/unresolved inner cavity - classified as a hint. Beam 20x16 mas = 3.1x2.5 au, PA_b = 62 deg; Sz 81A F_nu = 8.72 +/- 0.35 mJy; rms 41 uJy/beam. EB 21 Jul 2025 (Sz 81 A and B in the same primary beam).

images.wavelength_label: 0.87 mm continuum (343.5 GHz; robust 2.0; wide field with Sz 81 A and Sz 81 B)

paper.title: Probing Planet Formation within 10 au: Dust Substructures in Extremely Compact Protoplanetary Disks

images.note: Wide-field view of the Sz 81 binary: both components in one panel (labelled 'Sz 81 A' and 'Sz 81 B' inside the figure). Projected separation 1.93" = 304 au at 157.2 pc; PA of B relative to A = 19.5 deg (N through E), marked with a dashed line in the panel. Robust 2.0 image; the compact A and B disks are unresolved point-like sources here (R68 = 5.29 au for A, 4.50 au for B); F_nu = 8.72 +/- 0.35 mJy (A) and 3.72 +/- 0.64 mJy (B). Beam 20x16 mas, rms 41 uJy/beam. EB 21 Jul 2025. Colourbar of the original figure sits outside the panel and was trimmed.
